The Subtask Name: Second Data Gathering and Preliminary Comparison
Step Range: 2-3

Evidence: Planner directs WebSurfer to search for Kill Doctor Lucky, WebSurfer returns 1996 release date, Planner notes Icehouse (1989) vs Kill Doctor Lucky (1996) and decides to confirm exact Icehouse edition details.

The Subtask Name: Detailed Verification of Icehouse Release Year
Step Range: 4-19
The Oracle: Confirm the exact earliest release year and edition for Icehouse by navigating specific BoardGameGeek pages and verifying edition details.
Evidence: Planner repeatedly instructs WebSurfer to open specific BoardGameGeek URLs for Icehouse: The Martian Chess Set, WebSurfer executes multiple identical or near-identical searches and page loads (steps 4 through 19) attempting to extract the specific year (1989 vs 1999) from the page content, showing a repetitive pattern of tool usage without successful extraction of the final confirmation in the provided text.
